details.title: AI Engineer
details.short_description: As an AI Engineer on the Applied AI team, you will build and ship features that use large language models on top of our claims data. You will own well-defined components end to end, such as a retrieval pipeline or an evaluation harness, working closely with a senior engineer on design and with product and data partners on what to build.
